powershell.semanticNotes: Get-Location returns a PathInfo object; its .Path is the cwd. pwd prints a bare string. The displayed form differs slightly but the directory is the same.

summary: Change the runtime's working directory for subsequent commands.

node.semanticNotes: `cd` cannot be a spawned child process — a child's chdir does not affect the parent runtime. The @node adapter updates the runtime's in-process cwd (validating the target exists) so subsequent commands inherit it. There is intentionally no posix/powershell spawn form.

summary: Read the value of an environment variable.

node.semanticNotes: Reading env via a spawned shell (echo $VAR / $env:VAR) requires shell expansion the runtime never invokes. The @node adapter reads process.env[name] directly, identically on every platform.

summary: Set an environment variable for subsequent runtime commands.

node.semanticNotes: A child process cannot mutate the parent's environment, so export/$env: in a spawned shell would be lost immediately. The @node adapter sets process.env[name] in-process so the value persists for the session. riskDefault MEDIUM because env can alter the behavior of later commands (e.g. PATH, NODE_OPTIONS).
